title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reports.title: Un adolescente planificó con la Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros de colegio: fue detectado por el FBI y allanado en Quilmes
Cómo descubrió el FBI al chico de 15 años que organizaba con IA una masacre escolar en Quilmes y cuál era su plan
Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
Argentine federal police raided a home in Quilmes after the FBI legal attaché at the US embassy in Buenos Aires warned that a 15 year old had told ChatGPT he wanted to shoot classmates at his school. The teenager reportedly said the attack was first planned for 2027 but could be brought forward, and he showed interest in buying tactical gear. Officers seized two cell phones, two pairs of tactical gloves, a military style cap, two balaclavas, and protective goggles.

The investigation began on August 19 and was handled by anti-terrorism detectives, prosecutor Walter Bruno, and juvenile court judge Miriam Alcolcel. The boy's identity is being protected. He and his parents have been summoned to the juvenile prosecutor's office, and the seized items remain with the court in a public intimidation case. The article does not say whether the teenager has been charged or detained.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
